sentences.en: Packages of humanitarian aid are arriving from all over.
sentences.zh: 来自世界各地的人道主义援助物资正在陆续抵达。

sentences.en: Humanitarian personnel were evacuated as the fighting worsened.
sentences.zh: 随着战斗形势恶化，人道主义者被撤离了。

sentences.en: The conflict in Syria remains one of the largest humanitarian crises worldwide.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚冲突仍然是全球最大的人道危机之一。

senses.zh: 人道主义者，博爱主义者，慈善家；人道主义的，博爱的，慈善的 -
